what.title: What is multiple sclerosis? Who gets MS, numbers and symptoms
what.description: MS in animations: 2.8–3.1 million people worldwide, mostly women and young adults, more common far from the equator, and where the first attack strikes.

myelin.title: Myelin and demyelination in MS, animated: saltatory conduction
myelin.description: Watch a nerve signal jump node to node, then slow or stop as MS strips myelin. Sodium channels, remyelination, axon loss, Uhthoff heat and the delayed VEP.

immune.title: How the immune system attacks myelin in MS, animated
immune.description: Step through the MS immune attack: T and B cells activated in lymph nodes, crossing the blood-brain barrier via VLA-4, myelin damage, smouldering lesions.

risk.title: MS risk factors: HLA genes, EBV, vitamin D and smoking
risk.description: Is MS hereditary? HLA-DRB1*15:01, Epstein-Barr virus, vitamin D, smoking and teen obesity on one chart, with family risk as real percentages. Cited.

course.title: MS course over time: RRMS, SPMS, PPMS, PIRA and RIS explained
course.description: An animated 30-year MS timeline: relapses, residual deficits, PIRA, MRI lesions and brain volume across RRMS, SPMS and PPMS, with Lublin 2013 descriptors.

relapse.title: MS relapse week by week: steroids, recovery and pseudo-relapse
relapse.description: How an MS relapse unfolds over 26 weeks: gadolinium enhancement, steroid regimens, recovery time, residual deficit, and how a pseudo-relapse differs.

edss.title: EDSS explained: the MS disability scale and confirmed progression
edss.description: The EDSS 0–10 scale step by step with walking anchors, a teaching calculator, and how confirmed disability progression at 12 or 24 weeks works.

dx.title: McDonald criteria calculator (2017 and 2024) for MS diagnosis
dx.description: Place MRI lesions, add CSF bands, κ-FLC, OCT and central vein sign, and see the 2017 and 2024 McDonald criteria verdicts build step by step. Learning aid.

ddx.title: MS differential diagnosis: NMOSD, MOGAD and other mimics
ddx.description: How MS differs from NMOSD, MOGAD, small-vessel disease, migraine, B12 deficiency and more: MRI patterns, red flags and why misdiagnosis happens.

dmt.title: How MS drugs work: DMT mechanisms, trials and approvals
dmt.description: An animated map of where each MS disease-modifying therapy acts, from S1P modulators to natalizumab and anti-CD20, with label dosing, trials and FDA dates.

ladder.title: MS treatment ladder: escalation vs early high-efficacy DMT
ladder.description: How MS drugs are sequenced: step up after breakthrough or start high-efficacy early, what ECTRIMS/EAN and AAN 2018 say, and stopping after 55 (DISCOMS).

safety.title: Natalizumab PML risk, JCV index and MS drug monitoring
safety.description: Natalizumab PML risk by JCV index, prior immunosuppressants and months on drug, plus label monitoring, rebound, pregnancy wording and vaccines on MS DMTs.

cure.title: MS cure research: BTK, remyelination, aHSCT
cure.description: Where MS cure research stands: BTK inhibitors (tolebrutinib), remyelination, aHSCT, EBV and CAR-T, with evidence labels and every trial result cited.

symptoms.title: MS symptoms and treatment: fatigue, walking, bladder, spasticity
symptoms.description: A body map of 12 multiple sclerosis symptoms: how common each is, drug and non-drug options with evidence labels, and the fampridine and fatigue trials.

living.title: Living with MS: pregnancy, smoking, life expectancy and work
living.description: MS relapse rates through pregnancy (PRIMS, Kaiser), breastfeeding, smoking and progression, life expectancy, work, heat, diet, driving and care planning.

nursing.title: MS nursing care: assessment, infusions and monitoring
nursing.description: How nurses assess MS (T25FW, 9HPT, SDMT, FSS), run ocrelizumab infusions, monitor fingolimod first doses and DMT labs, and teach. Cited.

history.title: History of multiple sclerosis: Charcot to McDonald 2024
history.description: An animated MS timeline: d'Esté's diary, Carswell and Charcot, EAE, the first MRI, interferon and glatiramer, EBV and the 2024 McDonald criteria.

review.title: MS flashcards & mnemonics: McDonald, EDSS, DMTs
review.description: 79 multiple sclerosis flashcards and 10 mnemonics, from EBV and myelin to McDonald 2024, DMT safety and pregnancy, with an animated two-places-two-times rule.

quiz.title: Multiple sclerosis quiz: 78 questions with explanations
quiz.description: Test yourself on MS: McDonald 2017 vs 2024, κ-FLC and OCB, EDSS, DMT mechanisms, PML risk, PRIMS, NMOSD red flags and nursing monitoring.

glossary.title: Multiple sclerosis glossary: 130 terms explained
glossary.description: Searchable MS glossary from κ-FLC, PIRA and Select-6 to S1P modulators, NMOSD and PML, with citations and links to the module where each term matters.

sources.title: MS Companion sources: 510 checked references
sources.description: Every reference behind MS Companion, each checked against PubMed, Europe PMC, Crossref, ClinicalTrials.gov or openFDA. Filter by area or search.
